name: maybe_Field_Scene_TestPointInBoxSet
summary: Tests a world point against the scene's 0x60-byte oriented-box set copied from scene+0x38C, converting each box to its local frame and stopping at the first containing box; the boolean result was dropped by Ghidra.
evidence: Only caller Event_Rura_Start; callees std_memcpy of 0x60 bytes from +0x38C, Math_BuildQuaternionFromEuler, Math_BuildBoundsFromSphereAndOffset; body returns on hit paths.

name: maybe_Ui_Layout_BuildQuadTransforms
signature: void maybe_Ui_Layout_BuildQuadTransforms(LayoutSet* self, u32 dst, u32 count, LayoutEntry* entries, float scale)
summary: Turns layout element sprite records into per-quad vertex coordinates, handling rotation via std_FastSinCos and the arbitrary-quad UV path, caching results with a built flag.
evidence: 12 callers are UI layout/sprite setup functions (Ui_LayoutText_AppendGlyphPositions, Ui_Part_SetupFromAnimRecord, Ui_Poker_SetCardSprite); callees std_FastSinCos and Ui_LayoutElement_BuildTransform.

name: maybe_Ui_Part_UpdateSlotTransforms
signature: void maybe_Ui_Part_UpdateSlotTransforms(void* part, u32 frame, u32* timer)
summary: Per-frame transform update for an effect part: rebuilds up to four slot rotations from angle fields with trig helpers, applies stored transform blocks and clamps the part bounding box.
evidence: Only caller Ui_HorseraceReceptMsg_Release; callees Sound_Emitter_SetPositionAndDirection, Math_ComputeRotatedAabb, Menu_Cursor_Resolve, std_Ceilf/std_Expf; owning class ambiguous.

name: maybe_Ui_SpriteActor_CreateCharacterSprite
summary: Builds a 2D character sprite for a UI sprite actor: resolves the character master record and attaches sprite children.
evidence: Only caller maybe_Gfx_MeshNode_InitChildren; callees Gfx_SpriteActor_AddChildC, Gfx_AddFColAnimator, Object_IsHandleAlive, Data_FindRowByPackedKeys; sprite creation supported but caller tentative.

name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_MoveAttachmentTowardTarget
summary: Moves the attachment of the referenced actor toward its target: clears the attachment, computes and normalises the direction to the target fields, applies the step and plays the SE.
evidence: No callers; callees Field_Actor_UpdateAttachment, Gfx_EffectPart_SetDirection, Sound_PlaySeById; position subtraction/normalisation clear but f_234 scale unexplained.

name: maybe_Trail_UpdateGeometry
summary: Rebuilds trail/ribbon vertex geometry for the current frame: samples spline points and constructs quad strip vertices.
evidence: Callers Gfx_Node_UpdateChildren and maybe_Trail_UpdateDirection; callees Field_Collision_RaycastScene, Math_MatrixInverse, Math_RebuildBasis, Gfx_GetSceneSpriteContext; large body only partially recovered.

name: maybe_Ui_Overlay_CalcAnchorMatrix
signature: void maybe_Ui_Overlay_CalcAnchorMatrix(u32* out, UiOverlay* ctx, u32 nodeId)
summary: Builds the world transform of a UI-overlay anchor node: seeds output with identity, overwrites the basis with the node matrix, composes model frame/skeleton-scale fields and writes the resulting position.
evidence: All five callers resolve an anchor id through Ui_Overlay_GetAnchorIdByName on the overlay manager (work+0x48) and pass it here (Battle_Ui_PlaceMarkerOnModel, Camera_ResolveCollision, Camera_Update, Model_ComputeAttachmentAnchor).

name: maybe_Menu_CheckActorAnimationDone
summary: Returns true when the menu actor with the given id has finished its animation: scans the four party lists, matches the actor resolved by Monster_LookupRecord, compares the record frame counter with a threshold and updates a per-actor retry counter.
evidence: No callers; callees Monster_LookupRecord, Ui_Widget_CountChildren, Math_RandomChanceBelow, Model_SetupPartsFromTable; 'animation finished' still depends on the threshold constant.

name: maybe_Field_ActorAction_UpdateJump
summary: Integrates a field actor jump: applies gravity/velocity, clamps Y to the ground range via the ground query, and snaps the actor on landing.
evidence: Ground query func_005AFB34 and landing branch func_003BB1D4 are visible; jump globals g_fieldActorActionJumpParam/Gravity; no callers, so still inferred.

name: Camera_ShouldRefreshPathPoint
signature: u32 Camera_ShouldRefreshPathPoint(void* cam, const float* reference, const float* point, const float* dir, float angleLimit)
summary: Returns 0 while the candidate point stays within the data row's max distance and inside the forward cone, 1 otherwise; used by the camera path updater to decide whether to refresh the path point.
evidence: Both callers are Camera_UpdateWorkPath and maybe_Camera_UpdateWorkPathEx; reads Data row f_1C max distance and compares acos of dot with angle limit.

name: maybe_Camera_ComputeViewTransform
signature: void maybe_Camera_ComputeViewTransform(float* out, CameraParams* mode, float* src, float* target)
summary: Builds a camera view/orbit transform: normalises the look direction, derives yaw/pitch, rotates the offset by the quaternion and writes the eye position and orientation components.
evidence: Only caller is Camera_Field_Update; geometry readable but output layout/param meaning unclear.

name: Gfx_ScreenFade_ApplyPreset
signature: void Gfx_ScreenFade_ApplyPreset(GfxScreenFade* self, const float* preset)
summary: Applies one of the four screen-fade presets: copies preset floats into the fade state, seeds mode bytes and converts preset[3] into the signed orientation angle.
evidence: Caller Gfx_ScreenFade_Update indexes the four-entry table g_007A61A0 by (f_54+1)%4 and passes the row; body writes fade state fields.

name: maybe_Monster_GetAttackStat
summary: Computes a three-field monster stat (f_738+f_EB8+f_AF8) either raw or scaled by a vtable-derived factor, then marks the row layout dirty.
evidence: Reads the same f_738/f_EB8/f_AF8 triple as the attack-power variants; caller Field_CheckZonePoint is unrelated; 'Attack' still inferred.

name: maybe_Motion_ApplyRotationBlend
signature: void maybe_Motion_ApplyRotationBlend(float* out, Motion* first, Motion* b)
summary: Second half of the motion blend: rotates the blended offset, normalises it and stores the resulting float3.
evidence: Neighbours Math_QuatFromAxisAngle/std_Acosf match rotate/normalise maths, but body reads in_fpscr/s0 (damaged floats) and rotation helpers unnamed.

name: Fx_UpdateParticleE
summary: Integrates one particle of emitter type E: applies speed/gravity/steering flags, advances keyframe/scale/rotation tracks and writes the vertex position into the effect command buffer.
evidence: Caller maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleListR dispatches per particle next to maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleA; writes PICA command block and calls Fx_AddParticleOffset/Fx_UpdateParticleTarget.

name: maybe_Fx_UpdateEmitterTransform
summary: Emitter frame update that also rebuilds the emitter transform: reads the owner clock, runs target/curve/transform updates and draw-list calls.
evidence: No named caller (only maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleTrail); callees shared with near-identical 0x0052C26C, so which is the transform update is unsettled.

name: maybe_Gfx_Effect_UpdatePlacement
summary: Projects an effect's world offset to screen space, scaling by camera distance clamped to a near/far range, then lets the owner apply it via virtual +0x24.
evidence: Calls Gfx_ProjectWorldToScreen and reads the camera child at (work+8)+0x74; no callers and the owning class is inferred from layout only.

name: maybe_Ui_ChildTransform_UpdateRotatedRow
summary: Lays out up to 0x20 children at self+0xB64 as a rotating row, deriving each child's position/rotation from the parent transform and ring angle via std_FastSinCos.
evidence: No callers (virtual update); only named callees are std_FastSinCos and Game_GetWork, so the class and rotated-row purpose remain inferred.

name: maybe_Actor_UpdateSkullRunPose
summary: Forces the model's "Skull_Run" animation node, derives the facing basis and acos angle from the node position, and hands the aim to Math_Vec3_LookAtRotationMatrix.
evidence: Literal s_Skull_Run and node block at model+0x324..0x33C are the only evidence; no callers, and the body matches 0x5929EC.

name: maybe_Fx_EmitParticlesRandomRadius
summary: Emission variant that randomises the spawn radius (one RNG draw, then sqrt of squared radius) before handing each particle to the shared quad builder.
evidence: Shared Fx_BuildParticleRenderQuad callee supports emit-variant reading, but radius distribution is inferred from arithmetic and there is no direct caller.

name: maybe_Fx_EmitParticlesRandomOriented
summary: Emission variant drawing three random angles and multiplying them into a rotation matrix so each spawned particle gets its own orientation before the quad is built.
evidence: Fx_BuildParticleRenderQuad callee plus 0x12551C matrix multiply support oriented emission, but orientation is inferred from the three angle draws and there is no caller.

name: maybe_Fx_EmitParticlesRing
summary: Ring/disc emission: takes a random radius factor, scales it by (1 - distance/radius) and a square root, orients the offset with the 16-byte RNG table at g_005209A8, and writes the quad.
evidence: Shared quad builder is confidently named; ring/disc shape inferred from the radial factor and RNG-table orientation, not from a caller.

name: maybe_Fx_EmitParticlesSphere
summary: Spherical-shell emission: computes radius as sqrt((1 - r) + r^2*(1 - r)) so particles land on the emitter's sphere surface, then builds the quad.
evidence: Shared Fx_BuildParticleRenderQuad callee is confident; sphere formula is a body reading only and no caller confirms the emitter type.

name: maybe_Fx_EmitParticlesOriented
summary: Fully oriented emission: builds a 4x4 basis from the three stored angles, optionally rotates the particle direction with 0x12551C, and writes the quad.
evidence: Shared quad builder and 0x12551C multiply are visible, but 'oriented' is inferred from the matrix build; callers are only other maybe_Fx_UpdateParticle* functions.

name: maybe_Fx_EmitParticlesCone
summary: Cone-shaped particle emission: advances the emitter lifetime accumulator, computes a radial falloff and emits each particle through the shared quad builder.
evidence: Calls Fx_BuildParticleRenderQuad, Fx_InitSpawnedParticle, Fx_Group_UpdateEmitters; falloff formula only, no named caller confirms the cone shape.

name: maybe_Fx_EmitParticlesArc
summary: Arc-shaped particle emission: steps the angle by 1/(count-1) and emits particles along the rotating axis via the shared quad builder.
evidence: Even-angle stepping visible in body; calls Fx_BuildParticleRenderQuad/Fx_InitSpawnedParticle; no caller corroborates.

name: maybe_Fx_EmitParticlesRandomB
summary: Random-distribution emission variant using an RNG draw, square root and the shared quad builder; differs from sibling variants only in inherited emitter fields.
evidence: Only shared builder is confident; caller Os_ReadChunkedTable is unrelated; no constant distinguishes the variant.

name: maybe_Fx_EmitParticlesRandomOrientedB
summary: Random-orientation emission variant: one RNG draw, a matrix multiply and two square roots, writing orientation fields before the quad build.
evidence: Same body family as 0x5227C8/0x5232C8; no caller or constant proves the difference.

name: maybe_Fx_EmitParticlesRandomOrientedC
summary: Third random-orientation emission variant, differing from 0x522BA8 only in which particle fields it inherits from the emitter.
evidence: Same body family; no external evidence distinguishes it.

name: maybe_Fx_EmitParticlesRadialC
summary: Radial emission variant driven by the emitter lifetime accumulator, computing a random radius and writing the particle quad.
evidence: Shared builder confirmed; u32 return unexplained and no caller corroborates the radial shape.

name: maybe_Fx_EmitParticlesRadialD
summary: Radial emission variant with one square root per particle and a different RNG table, suggesting a flat-disc distribution.
evidence: Shared builder confirmed; flat-disc reading only from arithmetic, no caller corroboration.

name: maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleListJ
signature: float maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleListJ(int self, float dt, float* particle, float* extra)
summary: Per-particle update variant: integrates the particle, resolves the parent transform, emits sprite quads and links the particle into the active/free lists.
evidence: Called by Fx_UpdateParticleListQ for emitter kind 6; heavy FP control flow, no field or helper pins the variant.

name: maybe_Battle_UpdateSkullRunAnchor
summary: Per-frame anchor update for a combat action: sets the 'Skull_Run' animation, computes an attached transform, offsets the node position, and builds a normalized look-at basis via Math_Vec3_LookAtRotationMatrix.
evidence: String 'Skull_Run' and Math_Vec3_LookAtRotationMatrix callee support the action-anchor reading, but no caller names the combat action, so the SkullRun attribution stays inferred.

name: maybe_Field2D_Sprite_BuildTransformMatrix
summary: Builds a 2D sprite's world matrix, either billboarded toward the camera via Camera_SetupLookAtBasis or from its own rotation, plus scale and translation.
evidence: Camera_SetupLookAtBasis/Camera_SetupPerspective callees and the billboard-vs-own-rotation branch are visible, but no caller confirms the sprite class.

name: maybe_Field2D_Sprite_BuildTransformMatrixB
summary: Byte-identical twin of 0x005B0430: same billboard/own-rotation sprite matrix build with scale and translation.
evidence: Same body as 0x005B0430 (identical callee set and constants); no caller identifies which sprite class selects this copy.

name: maybe_Gfx_UpdateScreenEntries
summary: Per-frame update of per-screen view entries: walks the two screen blocks and updates each entry's transform, copying the resulting basis vectors.
evidence: Named caller Ui_SceneFlow_Update calls it every frame with the camera/2D-manager object; two 0xABC-apart blocks and float transform mix visible, but per-screen reading is inferred from layout.

name: maybe_Ui_Overlay_ComputeDistanceScale
signature: void maybe_Ui_Overlay_ComputeDistanceScale(float* out, float* pos, float* scale)
summary: Builds a billboard/overlay scale from the distance between a point and the reference object at work+0x74, clamping to configured limits and optionally applying the actor field factor.
evidence: Both callers are named UI code (Ui_Overlay_UpdateTransform, Ui_Window_ProjectWorldSlot) that add the returned offset to the overlay position; reference object still inferred.

name: maybe_Monster_Model_ApplyVariant
signature: u32 maybe_Monster_Model_ApplyVariant(MonsterModel* self, MonsterModelContext* ctx, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
summary: Applies one optional monster-model variant: for context states 0x151/0x21B it creates the variant object, toggles animation layers with the variant scale, then runs Anim_UpdateChannels/Model_UpdateMotionState.
evidence: Named callees Anim_UpdateChannels, Model_UpdateMotionState and Event_ActorModels_CreateSpritePart confirm the animation-layer part, but the two variant ids remain unlabelled.

name: maybe_Event_ActorModels_SetModelAnim
signature: void maybe_Event_ActorModels_SetModelAnim(EventActorModels* self, u32 archive, EventModel* model, u32 animId)
summary: Switches an event actor model animation: builds the %s.ani resource name, loads it from the archive, resolves the model entry and applies it, with a special path for expression 0x36.
evidence: Handle lookup and class check are named (Event_ActorModels_FindModelByHandle, Model_IsInstance) and a simplified variant exists at 0x004B979C; body is damaged (in_ZR/in_r12), so kept maybe.

name: maybe_Fx_EmitParticlesFromGlobalVelocity
summary: Particle spawn loop that takes each particle's velocity from the global constant vector instead of the emitter's random table, clamps the spawn count and hands each particle to the shared quad builder.
evidence: Shared builder Fx_BuildParticleRenderQuad and node allocator 0x00530798 are named, supporting the spawn-loop reading; the emitter type selecting this variant is still inferred.

name: maybe_Fx_EmitParticlesRadialSpread
summary: Emitter spawn routine that builds particle quads via Fx_BuildParticleRenderQuad/Fx_InitSpawnedParticle; the radial-spread reading rests only on square roots and axis constants.
evidence: No callers; callees are the shared particle builder/init and Fx_Group_UpdateEmitters; body matches the sibling emission variants but the shape is inferred.

name: maybe_Fx_EmitParticlesBox
summary: Emitter spawn routine splitting the spawn count between two axes with the LCG and offsetting particles along the chosen axis; box shape inferred from the two-axis split.
evidence: Callers are unnamed maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleD/H; callees are the shared builder/init; no named caller confirms the emitter type.

name: maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleA
summary: Per-particle integration step: advances position/velocity, applies steering and keyframe scale, called once per particle from the particle-list updaters.
evidence: Callers maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleListR/U pass one particle per iteration; callees Fx_UpdateParticlePosition/Fx_AddParticleOffset/Fx_UpdateParticleTarget; the A ordinal is arbitrary.

name: maybe_Gfx_CharModel_UpdateProjMatrices
summary: When the per-slot dirty flag is set, computes the inverse of the slot's 4x4 transform and writes it into the projection-texture matrix slots before rebuilding render state.
evidence: Caller Gfx_Model_DrawOverlayPasses; callees Fx_DistributionTable_WriteEntry/Math_TransformOffsetPoint/Gfx_InitStaticDescriptors; which resource the slots represent is unproven.

name: maybe_Node_InitAttachmentFromParent
signature: void maybe_Node_InitAttachmentFromParent(NodeAttachment* node, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
summary: Initialises an attachment node: sets defaults, copies the parent's twelve transform words into f_40..f_64 and resolves the 'N_ALL' anchor id into f_94.
evidence: Body copies parent transform and calls Ui_Overlay_GetAnchorIdByName with "N_ALL"; no allocation, so not a ctor; no callers to confirm the node type.

name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_ApplyPartTint
summary: Builds a model descriptor from a part name and applies formation tinting through Field_ActorGroup_ApplyFormation.
evidence: Callees Field_ActorGroup_ApplyFormation/Field_Gimmick_InitComponentC/Ui_GetCore; callers are unnamed gimmick helpers; tint property mapping inferred.

name: maybe_Gfx_ModelPart_InitMeshOnly
summary: Minimal model-part initialiser: copies position params, registers a fixed two-entry fCol colour block at scale 1.0, then creates the mesh from params[3].
evidence: Caller maybe_Field_SceneSpawnBlock_ModelPartMeshOnly; callees Gfx_AddFColAnimator/Gfx_CreateMeshObjectByParams; body lacks the sprite-child and rotation steps of the fuller variant.

name: maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleListI
signature: int maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleListI(int self, int particle, int keyframe, int flags)
summary: Per-particle update that walks the particle's child chain, emits sprite quads and advances the shared vertex-stream pointer in batches.
evidence: Only caller Fx_UpdateParticleListQ dispatches it for emitter kind 5; callees Fx_AppendNodeData/Fx_Group_UpdateEmitters plus unnamed sprite/rotation helpers; batch size and offsets are decompiler inferences.

name: maybe_Fx_UpdateEmitterFrame
summary: Advances an emitter timeline from the owner clock at +0x53C, destroys the emitter when the timeline expires, and updates target/curve/transform sub-emitters. No callers and near-identical to 0x0052F10C, so the frame-vs-transform split remains an interpretation.
evidence: Callees Fx_EmitterRandomizeSpawn/Fx_DestroyEmitter and maybe_Fx_UpdateEmitterTarget; reads owner +0x53C and +0x284; no callers to pin the class.

name: maybe_Field_Actor_ClampDirection
signature: void maybe_Field_Actor_ClampDirection(FieldActorMoveTask* self, float* dir, float* outLen)
summary: Normalises the combined field move vector, returns its length through outLen, and rotates it into the actor's facing frame (live camera/actor matrix at work+0x74 or the saved copy when hasOwnRotation is set).
evidence: Calls Field_GetCombinedMoveVector and Math_BuildBoundsFromSphereAndOffset plus 0x00574548 rotate; reads self->hasOwnRotation and work+0x74; no callers to confirm the owning class.
